noncomputable def ZeroMassesOn (U : Set Plane) (u : State Point) : Prop :=
  ∀ n s, s ∈ U → CorrectionState.radialMoment 2 u.mean.angular n s = 0 ∧
    CorrectionState.radialMoment 1 u.mean.axial n s = 0
